questions.q: An agency relationship created when a principal conducts themselves in a manner that leads third parties to reasonably believe that a person is their authorized agent is known as agency by...
questions.explain: Agency by **estoppel** (or implied agency) occurs when a principal's words or conduct lead a third party to believe someone is their agent. The law "estops" (prevents) the principal from later denying the agency relationship.

questions.q: Which of the following represents a fundamental legal duty that an agent owes to their principal?
options: To freely delegate all assigned duties to a sub-agent without permission.
To mix the principal's business funds with their personal funds.
To act in utmost good faith and avoid any conflict of interest.
To sell the principal's goods at the lowest possible price to friends.
questions.explain: An agent is a fiduciary of the principal. Their duties include: following instructions, demonstrating reasonable skill, rendering true accounts, not delegating duties without permission, and acting in **utmost good faith (avoiding conflicts of interest)**.
